primary.title: Nifty earnings estimates ambitious but a weak rupee doesn’t complicate outlook: Nuvama’s Prateek Parekh
primary.summary: A weak rupee acts as a net positive for earnings by boosting export-heavy sectors, even though it presents challenges for consumer-facing segments and margins facing broader supply shocks
